resources.string: Forge actual pieces for four slots, choose a tactical set and lend equipment freely between heroes. Two matching pieces activate a first bonus; four add another. Mixing two pairs also works, even across rarities. Permanent training and old gear upgrades remain on each hero. Pieces improve instantly up to level 10. Unequip a piece before dismantling it; this returns half its crafting and enhancement materials.

Reforging keeps this piece’s level, set, identity and owner. It pays the difference in recipe and enhancement materials, plus a reforging surcharge. Your early investment stays useful; high-quality gear still needs the matching forge rank and campaign progress.
Only unequipped pieces can be dismantled. The piece is consumed; recovered materials are always less than the amount spent.
For the front line: pieces add health, armor and an opening shield. Two pieces: +8% HP. Four: an additional +8 armor and a shield worth 12% of maximum HP.
For focused damage: pieces add attack and critical chance. Two pieces: +4% critical chance. Four: an additional +10% attack and +2% critical chance.
For frequent attacks and skills: pieces add haste. Two pieces: +4% haste. Four: an additional +4% haste and +8% skill strength.
For healers and support: pieces improve healing and health. Two pieces: +12% healing. Four: an additional +18% healing and an opening shield worth 6% of maximum HP.
For sustained duelling: pieces convert some damage dealt into personal healing. Two pieces: +5% lifesteal. Four: an additional +8% lifesteal and +6% HP.
For armored opponents: pieces penetrate armor and improve skills. Two pieces: ignore 8% of armor. Four: an additional +15% skill strength and 6% armor penetration.
